clauses.CSGA1_heat_shadow: W_kin=exp(-tau_int H_cl) Phi_C1^+ on the selected finite carrier
clauses.CSGA2_finite_matching_completeness: the represented finite trace action is complete at the matching point up to one common normalization; no extra relative F_a^2 term is added

name: ClosureShadowGaugeActionAxiom
statement: ClosureShadowGaugeActionAxiom. On a selected finite coherent sector with positive closure Hessian H_cl, selected C1 density Phi_C1^+, and selected proper time tau_int, the quadratic physical gauge shadow at the finite matching point is S_gauge^(2)=(1/2) Tr_HF(exp(-tau_int H_cl) Phi_C1^+ F^2). No additional sector-relative gauge-quadratic functional is present at that matching point; one common overall normalization is the already counted P_EW primitive.
